text:
Kori (Growth): Quick ask — need a mini asset set for the benchmark webinar + launch email. Deadline Wed EOD. Keep it editable for last-minute copy changes.

Riley (Design): What counts as a 'mini' set? sizes and content? :thinking_face:

Kori (Growth): Social single image (1200x628), square (1080x1080), story (1080x1920), email hero (1200x400), animated tile (600x600 GIF). Also 3 subject lines and 3 CTA options.

Maya P.: Highlight two metrics: avg latency 42ms (per-token) and ~2x cost improvement vs baseline. Copy should be short and factual.

Riley (Design): Noted. Deliver PNG+SVG for statics, GIF+MP4 for motion, Figma file, and a short README (colors, fonts, export names). Include retina exports.

Sam O.: Brand: use primary blue, neutral overlays, no neon. Provide white-bg press variants and 1px safety margin.

Leo (Design Ops): Use componentized Figma file with named layers. Accessibility: body text contrast >= 4.5:1.

Riley (Design): Wireframes today; first comps Tue AM, final Wed EOD. Naming convention: bench-mini-YYYYMMDD-<asset>-v1.{png,svg,gif,mp4}.

assets-bot: Placeholder file added — https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder/bench-mini-pack.

Maya P.: Draft subjects: 1) "New inference benchmarks: faster & cheaper" 2) "See how we cut avg latency" 3) "Benchmark snapshot: speed + cost"

Kori (Growth): CTA options: [Explore the report], [See pricing & perf], [Watch demo]. Pick at handoff. If blockers, DM me.

Riley (Design): Will upload comps to the figma link and tag reviewers. Thanks everyone.
